entries.desc: off 模式：合法 evidence → 本地写入、exit 0、零 authority POST（行为同 post-B-2157 main）

evidence.note: off-mode happy case: off short-circuits authorityModeEnabled, returns synchronous string, asserts offServer.calls==0 and local evidence written

entries.desc: shadow/enforce + 健康 server：完整本地 preflight 通过后才发 authority POST，POST 成功后才写本地 evidence

evidence.note: A-prepost ordering骨架: shadow/enforce run local preflight first, then POST, then writeLocal only on accepted POST; success-path building block + enforce submitter wiring exercised in flow smoke

entries.desc: batch_add 全部 entry 本地合法 → 全部写入 + 一次 coherent batch POST（all-or-nothing 的成功侧）

entries.desc: 本地 preflight 失败（itemId 不存在 / note<5 / waiverType-kind 不符 / intentRef 非法）→ authority server 收到 0 POST 且 0 本地写入（Blocker 1+2）

evidence.note: Blockers 1+2: illegal itemId / note<5 / waiverType-kind mismatch each assert server.calls==0 and zero local write via POST-counting fake AuthorityClient under enforce

entries.desc: batch_add 任一 entry 本地非法 → 整批 0 POST + 0 本地写入（all-or-nothing 失败侧，无 partial tail）

evidence.note: batch all-or-nothing failure side: any illegal entry (unknown item / short note) -> whole batch server.calls==0 and zero local write, no partial tail

entries.desc: shadow + 健康 server：本地写入 + authority POST + exit 0

evidence.note: shadow + healthy server case: handler POSTs once (server.calls===1) and writes local evidence, returns success message, exit 0, no stderr warning

entries.desc: shadow + 失败 server（5xx / timeout / connection-refused / client throw 任一）→ 本地 evidence 仍写入、exit 0、stderr 一行 [warning] authority POST failed

evidence.note: shadow + failing server cases (5xx http_error / timeout AbortError / connection-refused ECONNREFUSED): each keeps local evidence write, handler does not throw (exit 0), emits exactly one stderr [warning] authority POST failed line, warning never on stdout

entries.desc: shadow 模式下任何 authority 结果（含异常抛出）都不改变/不阻塞本地 evidence 状态——best-effort warning，绝不污染本地（Blocker 3）

evidence.note: shadow + client THROW (non-HTTP TypeError escaping classify, preMortem #2): submitter degradeThrow catch-all degrades to proceed=true + warning, command does not crash, local evidence still written; shadow batch failure writes ALL entries — proves any authority result (incl thrown exception) never blocks/mutates local evidence (Blocker 3)

entries.desc: enforce + 健康 server：完整本地 preflight → authority POST 成功 → 才写本地 evidence → exit 0

evidence.note: enforce + healthy server case: asserts no local evidence before POST, then exactly one POST (server.calls==1), then local evidence written, success message, exit 0 — proves A-prepost POST-before-write ordering

entries.desc: enforce + 失败 server：authority POST 失败 → 0 本地写入、exit 非零（pre-POST 顺序，不为离线可用性削弱 enforce）

evidence.note: enforce + failing server cases (5xx http_error / timeout AbortError / connection-refused ECONNREFUSED / authority-rejected 200+accepted:false): each handler throws a controlled gating error, exactly one POST attempted, re-read on-disk checklist shows ZERO local write — exit non-zero with no divergence

entries.desc: 无分叉窗口：enforce 下 authority 失败时本地始终无该 entry（pre-POST，不做 compensating rollback，无 kill-9 二阶段窗口）

evidence.note: no-divergence-window: enforce failure cases re-read the on-disk checklist via store.readChecklist and assert hasEvidence==false — the local write never ran (pre-POST ordering), so there is no compensating rollback and no kill-9 two-phase window; client THROW case also degraded to controlled gating error with zero local write

entries.desc: enforce batch_add：authority 拒整批或部分拒 → 0 本地写入（partial-accept 映射为整批失败）

evidence.note: enforce batch all-or-nothing: whole-batch rejection (accepted:false) AND partial-accept (results:[{accepted:true},{accepted:false}]) both map via isAuthorityBatchFullyAccepted to whole-batch failure -> handler throws, single batch POST, re-read checklist shows evidence.length==0 — the accepted subset is NOT written
